genomes.name: Second Red Day or 2% Drop
genomes.thesis: A red day after a 1% red day in a 1.9% five-day dip above the 50-day, or a 2% drop above the 200-day; out on the first 0.5% up day or after two bars.
genomes.rationale: round 3, Claude: the quick-flush leader without its trend legs

entry_rules.when: prev(ret1) < -0.01 and ret5 < -0.019 and close > sma50
